settings.title: How to use
settings.content:
• Take 1 tablespoon per day.
  • Add to a water bottle, shake, and drink. You can also add it to your smoothie or make a hot cup of tea.
  • Drink 3 to 4 bottles of water a day (just water) while you detox.

settings.title: Good to know
settings.content: Although herbs are relatively safe, they should be used with caution, as directed on products and/or as directed by your doctor or physician.

settings.title: 1 tablespoon a day
settings.text: Add to a water bottle, shake and drink. Or mix it into a smoothie or a hot cup of tea.

settings.title: Drink your water
settings.text: Drink at least 3 to 4 bottles of water a day while you detox. Just water.

settings.title: Pick your time
settings.text: Take it before bed, or when you’re home near a restroom. To slow it down, take less.

settings.title: Taking both?
settings.text: Total Belly + Total System together: half a tablespoon of each, mixed in one bottle.

settings.question: Can I take Total Belly Detox and Total System Detox together?
settings.answer: Yes, you can take both of our detoxes together. Our detox is amazing taken by itself, but together it is a powerhouse. If you take both, we suggest half a tablespoon of each, mixed together in a water bottle, as a tea, or added to a smoothie.

settings.question: How much water should I drink with the detox?
settings.answer: It is best to drink at least 3 to 4 bottles of water per day after you have taken the detox. Water helps flush your system and lets the detox work properly. (Just water.)

settings.question: When is the best time to take the detox?
settings.answer: The best time is before bed, or while you’re home or somewhere comfortable near a restroom. If you’re in the restroom more than normal, the product is working through your system. To slow it down, take a smaller dose.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer:
All orders take 7 to 10 business days to ship and go out through USPS. Once your order ships, you’ll get a USPS tracking number.

All orders need a signature on delivery. If no one is home, USPS will take the package to your nearest post office for pickup or redelivery. If a package isn’t picked up and comes back to us, we can ship it again for a $12 fee. Overseas orders can take up to 30 days.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Returns are accepted within 7 business days of delivery for unused products in their original packaging. Email [email] to start a return.
